title: Rest in Vishnu and Krishna
intro: Vishnu sustains: he rests on the serpent of time, serene, holding the world together. As Krishna he is the friend and teacher of the Gita. This practice is for coming to rest, and remembering that you are held.
offering: Tulsi, water, an act done without wanting credit.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: His peace
steps.text: Read this verse slowly: Vishnu, serene, resting on the serpent, who removes the fear of worldly life.

steps.title: A teaching to carry
steps.text: Krishna’s teaching on acting fully, without being ruled by the outcome.

steps.title: What I can let go of
steps.prompt: What outcome am I holding too tightly?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Offer the day as this verse does: whatever I do, I offer to Narayana.

after: Thursdays and Ekadashi days are traditionally his.
